arxiv-2112-07731.title: Toward a unified theory for the Hadley cell descending and ascending edges Journal: jas
arxiv-2112-07731.description: Abstract We present theories for the latitudinal extents of both Hadley cells throughout the annual cycle by combining our recent scaling for the ascending edge latitude ( Hill et al. 2021 ) with the uniform Rossby number ( Ro {\mathrm{Ro}} ), baroclinic instability-based theory for the poleward, descending edge latitudes of Kang and Lu 2012 .

arxiv-2211-04792.title: Relationship of the Green’s functions related to the Hill’s equation coupled to different boundary value conditions 1,2, Supported by Xunta de Galicia (Spain), project EM2014/032 and Grant PID2020-113275GB-I00 funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by “ERDF A way of making Europe” of the “Euro
arxiv-2211-04792.creator: Alberto Cabada, Lucía López-Somoza and Mouhcine Yousfi
arxiv-2211-04792.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alberto Cabada, Lucía López-Somoza and Mouhcine Yousfi. In this paper we will deduce several properties of the Green’s functions related to the Hill’s equation coupled to various boundary value conditions. In particular, the idea is to study the Green’s functions of the second order differential operator coupled to Neumann, Dirichlet, Periodic and Mixed boundary conditions, by expressing the Green’s function of a given problem as a linear combination of the Green’s function of the other ones.

arxiv-2303-03410.title: Islands in Non-Minimal Dilaton Gravity: Exploring Effective Theories for Black Hole Evaporation
arxiv-2303-03410.creator: Chih-Hung Wu and Jiuci Xu
arxiv-2303-03410.description: Abstract We start from ( 3 + 1 ) (3+1) -dimensional Einstein gravity with minimally coupled massless scalar matter, through spherical dimensional reduction, the matter theory is non-minimally coupled with the dilaton in ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -dimensions.

arxiv-2402-16191.title: Commutative Poisson algebras from deformations of noncommutative algebras Thanks: Partially supported by a the LMS (research in pairs) grant #42218
arxiv-2402-16191.creator: Alexander V. Mikhailov, Pol Vanhaecke
arxiv-2402-16191.description: Abstract . It is well-known that a formal deformation of a commutative algebra 𝒜 \mathcal{A} leads to a Poisson bracket on 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and that the classical limit of a derivation on the deformation leads to a derivation on 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , which is Hamiltonian with respect to the Poisson bracket.

arxiv-2402-19437.title: Differentially Private Worst-group Risk Minimization
arxiv-2402-19437.creator: Xinyu Zhou, Raef Bassily
arxiv-2402-19437.description: Abstract We initiate a systematic study of worst-group risk minimization under ( ϵ , δ ) (\epsilon,\delta) -differential privacy (DP). The goal is to privately find a model that approximately minimizes the maximal risk across p p sub-populations (groups) with different distributions, where each group distribution is accessed via a sample oracle.

arxiv-2502-10530.description: Abstract . Let X ≥ y ≥ 2 X\geq y\geq 2 , and let u = log ⁡ X log ⁡ y u=\frac{\log X}{\log y} . We say a number is y y -smooth if all of its prime factors are less than or equal to y y .

arxiv-2503-23906.title: Topologizability and related properties of the iterates of composition operators in Gelfand-Shilov classes Thanks: Mathematics Subject Classification 2020: 46F05,47B33.
arxiv-2503-23906.creator: Angela A. Albanese, Héctor Ariza
arxiv-2503-23906.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Angela A. Albanese, Héctor Ariza. We analyse the behaviour of the iterates of composition operators defined by polynomials acting on global classes of ultradifferentiable functions of Beurling type which are invariant under the Fourier transform. In particular, we determine the polynomials ψ \psi for which the sequence of iterates of the composition operator C ψ C_{\psi} is topologizable ( m m -topologizable) acting on certain Gelfand-Shilov spaces defined by mean of Braun-Meise-Taylor weights.

arxiv-2601-02191.title: Spectral signatures of bright grains determine chromospheric heating
arxiv-2601-02191.creator: Elias R. Udnæs, Tiago M. D. Pereira
arxiv-2601-02191.description: Abstract Chromospheric heating is an important ingredient in the energy budget of the solar atmosphere. Quantifying chromospheric heating from observations is a challenging task because spectral observations suffer from non-LTE effects, and heating events may take place at spatial, temporal, and spectral resolutions difficult to achieve by modern telescopes.

pmc-10536897.creator: Cristian Valdebenito, José Gaete, Claudio Osorio, Yuvaraja Dibdalli, Ángel Norambuena, Nathalie Lecaros, Cristian Carrasco, Héctor Reyes, Gabriel Abarca, Cesar Morales-Verdejo

All complexes reported here were characterized using 1H and 13C NMR, elemental analysis, and Mössbauer spectroscopy, which was performed for neutral and oxide compounds.

pmc-10685177.title: Assessment of Public Knowledge and Awareness on First-Aid Management of Epistaxis in Makkah, Saudi Arabia
pmc-10685177.creator: Raghad Y Shosho, Raghad O Al-Masoudi, Abdulwahab I Kamal, Abdulrahman F Kabli, Ahmed J Alzahrani, Hawra A Almusallam, Raad A Alqurashi, Abdulaziz T Baghdadi, Salman A Alosaimi, Mokhtar Shatla
pmc-10685177.description: Background: Epistaxis is a common medical problem requiring first aid. However, public awareness of proper first-aid techniques for epistaxis is limited. This study assessed the knowledge and attitudes toward first-aid epistaxis management among the general population in the Makkah region.Methods: A cross-sectional online survey was conducted with 1,259 participants from various regions in Makkah.

pmc-11434484.title: A Systematic Methodology for the Identification of the Chemical Composition of the Mongolian Drug Erdun-Uril Compound Utilizing UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap Mass Spectrometry
pmc-11434484.creator: Yanghui Huo, Kailin Li, Suyu Yang, Bo Yi, Zhihua Chai, Lingxuan Fan, Liangyin Shu, Bowen Gao, Huanting Li, Wei Cai
pmc-11434484.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The traditional Mongolian medicine Erdun-Uril is a conventional combination of 29 herbs commonly used for the treatment of cerebrovascular ailments. It has the effects of reducing inflammation, counteracting oxidative stress, and averting strokes caused by persistent cerebral hypoperfusion. Prior research on Erdun-Uril has predominantly concentrated on its pharmacodynamics and mechanism of action; however, there has been a lack of systematic and comprehensive investigation into its chemical constituents.

pmc-11435612.title: Assessing the Quality of Solvent-Assisted Lipid Bilayers Formed at Different Phases and Aqueous Buffer Media: A QCM-D Study
pmc-11435612.creator: Marta Lavrič, Laure Bar, Martin E Villanueva, Patricia Losada-Pérez, Aleš Iglič, Nikola Novak, George Cordoyiannis, Paolo Facci
pmc-11435612.description: Supported lipid bilayers (SLBs) are low-complexity biomimetic membranes, serving as popular experimental platforms to study membrane organization and lipid transfer, membrane uptake of nanoparticles and biomolecules, and many other processes. Quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation monitoring has been utilized to probe the influence of several parameters on the quality of SLBs formed on Au- and SiO2-coated sensors.

pmc-12589826.creator: Zhaoxiong Guo, Yuchan Liang, Tingfeng Li, Ao Li, Kangshun Zhu, Yongjian Guo, Wenxin Wang, Wensou Huang

Prior to angiography, dual CBCT and 99mTc-MAA injection, each patient underwent CTA scan.

pmc-12654700.title: Is the Ensemble Machine Learning Model a Reliable Method for Detecting Neoplastic Infiltration of Thyroid Cartilage in Laryngeal Cancers?
pmc-12654700.creator: Sermin Can, Ömer Türk, Muhammed Ayral, Günay Kozan, Mehmet Önür, Eyyüp Yagız, Mehmet Akdag, Fumio Otsuka
pmc-12654700.description: Background and Objectives: We aimed to apply the ensemble machine learning model to diagnose thyroid cartilage invasion detected in computer tomography (CT) images in laryngeal cancers and evaluate the diagnostic performance of the model. Materials and Methods: A total of 313 patients were divided into two groups: the cartilage invasion group and the no cartilage invasion group.

pmc-13239043.title: Temperature Trajectories Are Associated With the Prognosis of Septic Patients
pmc-13239043.creator: Keying Ding, Chang Xu, Xueqi Zhu, Hua Wang, Zhaojun Xu, Zhongqiu Lu, Shashank Kaushik
pmc-13239043.description: PurposeSepsis is a heterogeneous clinical syndrome, and identification of its subphenotypes is essential. We aimed to investigate the correlation between the different trajectories of temperature and outcomes in septic patients.Patients and methodsThis was a retrospective cohort study that included sepsis patients admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) of a tertiary care hospital.

pmc-13710584.title: Wellbeing While Waiting: Effectiveness and implementation of youth social prescribing for young people awaiting CAMHS support
pmc-13710584.creator: Daniel Hayes, Joely Wright, Alexandra Burton, Feifei Bu, Lou Sticpewich, Het Stuttard, Joanna Page, Alexandra Bradbury, Emeline Han, Jessica Deighton, Marc S Tibber, Shivangi Talwar, Daisy Fancourt
pmc-13710584.description: Prolonged waiting times for Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) leave many young people without structured support while awaiting specialist treatment. Social prescribing has been proposed as a community-based adjunct within CAMHS pathways; however, evidence regarding its safety and clinical impact remains limited.

uslaw-usc-t15-s713a11a.title: 15 U.S.C. § 713a–11a — Interest prohibited when reimbursing Corporation for net realized losses
uslaw-usc-t15-s713a11a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s713a11a.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 15 (Economic Recovery); Subchapter I (Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. After September 30, 1964, the portion of borrowings from Treasury equal to the unreimbursed realized losses recorded on the books of the Commodity Credit Corporation after September 30 of the fiscal year in which such losses are realized, shall not bear interest.

uslaw-usc-t16-s352.title: 16 U.S.C. § 352 — Game refuge; killing game
uslaw-usc-t16-s352.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s352.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter XXXIX (Denali National Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The said park is established as a game refuge, and no person shall kill any game in said park except under an order from the Secretary of the Interior for the protection of persons or to protect.
